decided_by: PI, 2026-10-01: one canonical Ours per scale; compare it with a no-role ablation on the identical seeds at every scale. Rerun no-role only; do not retrain or re-evaluate Ours.
THE_QUESTION: On the exact same 128 scenarios, what changes when we remove explicit ATTACK/DEFEND organization?
METHODOLOGY_TEXT: To isolate the effect of explicit role organization, the no-role specialists were additionally evaluated on the same sealed seed blocks used by the primary role-allocated system. The role-allocated checkpoints and confirmatory results were not changed. These matched no-role evaluations were conducted post hoc as ablations, using already-spent confirmatory seeds, and are therefore used only to estimate the within-seed effect of removing role organization rather than as new confirmatory evidence.
